# Tom Fabre

> Tom Fabre is a product and brand designer based in Madrid and co-founder of Binōme Studio. He designs brands, websites and digital products (branding, web design, UX/UI, strategy) with more than ten years of experience between Latin America and Europe. He works in Spanish, French and English and is available for new projects.

The portfolio has real URLs per language: Spanish at the root, English under /en/ and French under /fr/. Each project below links to its detail page. Full text of every project in all three languages is in llms-full.txt; structured data is in portfolio.json.

## About

- [Bio](https://tomfabre.com/en/bio/): Background, way of working, quick facts and personal links.
- [Contact](https://tomfabre.com/en/contact/): Email hey@tomfabre.com, contact form and profile links.
- [CV (PDF, English)](https://tomfabre.com/cv-alvaro-fabre-en.pdf): Curriculum vitae. Also available in [Spanish](https://tomfabre.com/cv-alvaro-fabre.pdf) and [French](https://tomfabre.com/cv-alvaro-fabre-fr.pdf).

## Projects

- [Contazara](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/contazara/): Branding · Web · Digital. Rebranding, website, and digital communications for Contazara. A refreshed identity that keeps what makes the brand recognisable.
- [À2pas](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/a2pas/): Product Design · UX/UI · Branding. A participatory platform connecting audiences, artists and venues to make new performances possible.
- [HappyLife](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/happylife/): Product Design · UX/UI. An app for discovering activities, meeting people, and making plans away from your phone. Designed to make finding good company feel easy.
- [Binōme Studio](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/binome/): Branding · Strategy · Web. The story of Binōme, an independent studio I co-founded to bring branding, digital design, and strategy together. From creating our own identity to working on real projects.
- [Yaypegs](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/yaypegs/): Art Direction · Motion Design. A universe of digital characters with thousands of possible combinations. The challenge: design an animation system that could bring them to life without losing their personality.
- [360estudio](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/360estudio/): Branding · Web design · Art direction. Branding and web design for 360estudio, an architecture studio specialising in healthcare spaces. An identity that made its way into the offices, too.
- [Mobile Experiences](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/mobile-experiences/): Product Design · UX/UI · Mobile Apps. From designing complete apps from scratch to helping evolve products with millions of downloads. Three mobile design experiences across iOS and Android.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://tomfabre.com/en/services/): Three ways to work together.
- [Branding & identity](https://tomfabre.com/en/services/branding/): A brand with something to say. I create and renew brand identities. People recognize you, and they understand what makes you different.
- [Web design & development](https://tomfabre.com/en/services/web-design/): A good website should do more than look good. I design and build websites that are clear, fast and easy to use. Visitors know what to do next.
- [Digital product, UX/UI & digital strategy](https://tomfabre.com/en/services/ux-ui-design/): Less friction. More purpose. I design and improve digital products so people understand them and use them easily. Business goals stay in focus.
